fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-06-16, around 16:45, several unauthorised transfers totalling Rs. 3,50,000 were noticed in the account of the complainant, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-06-17. The complainant alleged that Ajith Nathan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000297. The account reference SYN-ACC-100044 was noted in connection with the payment. A further person, Murugan Sundaram, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000207, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00367, as the mobile number 9000000297 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Funds reportedly routed through a chain of accounts.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, suspect, afternoon, main street, receiving account, mobile number, transaction record
